blocks.text: Disgruntled fans did not hide their disappointment with the recent swimsuit show at the 2026 Miss Universe pageant in Puerto Rico, and took to social media to express their dismay. An event that is part of the activities marking the international pageant’s 75th edition earned the ire of many loyal followers, rather than elicit excitement for the milestone celebration. Fans were quick to point out the dismal staging of the “Beauty on the Beach” show at the Caribe Hilton Hotel in San Juan on Nov. 13 (14 in Manila).
